criteria.criterion: Per key, the value is the VLOOP_<KEY> variable when set and not empty, else .vloop/config.local.toml when it sets the key, else .vloop/config.toml when it sets the key, else the default.
criteria.evidence: config.go resolve: layers file then local, env applied last; TestLocalPrecedence covers all four layers

criteria.criterion: A list key takes the whole list of the layer that wins (never a merge of two files); an empty list (metrics.code = []) in either file sets nothing, so the next layer decides.
criteria.evidence: resolveList overwrites per layer and skips empty; TestLocalListWholeAndEmpty

criteria.criterion: A value from the local file has source local: `agent.work=claude (local)` in config list, "source":"local" in config list --json and config get --json; the sources default, file and env keep their names. Violation: a key resolved from the local file whose source prints as file.
criteria.evidence: SourceLocal = "local" set from l.source; asserted in TestLocalPrecedence

criteria.criterion: An empty local file, or one holding only keys vloop does not know, changes nothing and is no error.

A bad value or malformed TOML in the local file is reported like the shared file's, with the local path, exit 1: `vloop: .vloop/config.local.toml: invalid value "nope" for agent.work: want one of claude, copilot`.
criteria.evidence: SourceError uses l.path / LocalFilePath; TestLocalBadValueAndMalformed asserts the exact message

criteria.criterion: A [[check]] in the local file is an error, exit 1, on every command that reads the config (config list and config get included), with exactly `vloop: .vloop/config.local.toml: [[check]] belongs in .vloop/config.toml — the checks are the repository's, not one machine's`. Violation: any path (Checks, the planner's check copy, doctor) that returns or runs a check defined in the local file.
criteria.evidence: readLocal refuses key check; Checks, Get and List all go through readLayers; TestLocalCheckRefused asserts the exact text for all three. The remaining direct readFile callers (AddChecks and the writer) read only the shared file.

criteria.criterion: The local file is read wherever and whenever .vloop/config.toml is read today, ResolveRun at a run's start included; no read point is added or moved. With no local file, every output is byte-identical to before.
criteria.evidence: Only Checks, Get and List read via readLayers, the same points as before. ResolveRun reaches the config through Get. A missing local file gives an empty map.

criteria.criterion: The config package's committed tests cover, in temporary directories: the precedence of all four layers, the list rule and the empty list, source local, the local bad-value and malformed-TOML errors, and the [[check]] refusal; the go check runs them. A task that ships this behaviour and leaves no such test behind fails.
criteria.evidence: internal/config/local_test.go has 5 tests; the go check passed (exit 0)

criteria.criterion: No new dependency: the TOML library in use stays the only one.
criteria.evidence: go.mod and go.sum are not in the diff
